Job Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer — Safety & Deployment
Job Description: We are looking for a senior machine learning engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade ML systems that detect, mitigate, and monitor undesired or unsafe behaviors in large language models. You will work across model development, inference serving, and observability to ensure robust, low-latency behavior-control pipelines, and collaborate closely with research, product, and SRE teams to ship safe, reliable ML features.
Company description: SentinelAI Labs builds tools and platforms that help organizations detect and mitigate unsafe or harmful behavior in large language models and AI systems. We combine research-grade detectors, deployment tooling, and human-in-the-loop workflows to make AI behavior safer and auditable at scale.
responsibilities: Design and implement ML-based detectors and classifiers for identifying unsafe or undesired model outputs.
Build scalable, low-latency inference pipelines and orchestrate model serving (containerized services, autoscaling, batching strategies).
Integrate rule-based filters, classifiers, and runtime mitigations into a cohesive behavior-control pipeline.
Collaborate with research teams to productionize prototypes and iterate on model improvements.
Implement monitoring, alerting, and evaluation metrics for model performance, drift, and safety regressions.
Optimize model training and inference cost using mixed precision, quantization, and efficient infrastructure patterns.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices (code review, testing, CI/CD, documentation).
experience_requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years working on machine learning systems.
Proven track record deploying ML models to production and operating them at scale.
Experience designing low-latency inference systems and optimizing throughput/latency trade-offs.
Prior experience working cross-functionally with research, product, and site reliability engineering teams.
Experience with model evaluation, A/B testing, and establishing production metrics for ML models.
technical_skills: Cloud platforms (AWS/GCP) — deployment and infra for ML (SageMaker, ECS, EKS, or equivalent)
CI/CD for ML (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, MLflow)
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, structured logging, tracing
Datastores: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible object storage
Performance optimization: batching, mixed-precision, quantization, model sharding
Testing & validation: unit/integration tests, synthetic evaluation suites
education_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Master's or PhD in ML, AI, or related field preferred but not required.
other_requirements: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.
Authorization to work in the hiring country.
Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving research-to-product environment.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations for production services (limited).
Demonstrated commitment to engineering quality: code reviews, testing, and documentation.
